items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Buster Harding, and the interviewee confirms he was arranging for Cab Calloway, but the interviewee does not claim a personal or professional relationship with Harding himself.

ctx.x: I worked with Don on one of his recording dates. And that was all. But I knew Don very well. We used to play Hearts together. Yeah, Don. Very good arranger. Don Redman.
Buster Harding, yeah. Yeah, he was arranging then for Cab. Andy Gibson arranged for me.
